newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell by 294,000 barrels in the week ended October 23 to 10.634 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks fell by 876,000 barrels to 7.827 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks rose by 685,000 barrels to 6.092 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
